responsibility: Autogenerated option-documentation mapping file for the GNU Modula-2 front end that complements `gcc/m2/lang.opt`. It assigns GCC option names to manual URL suffixes used by GCC’s option metadata/documentation machinery, including shared GCC links and language-specific overrides where Modula-2 reuses D or Fortran documentation anchors, and records cases skipped because one option maps to multiple manual locations. Its stable role is to provide the generated documentation-link table for gm2 command-line options rather than to define option semantics, parsing, or driver behavior.
